description: This file defines the ContentModerationConfigureForm class, a Drupal form for configuring content moderation workflows, including entity type selection and default moderation state.

classes.name: ContentModerationConfigureForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring content moderation workflows, extending WorkflowTypeConfigureFormBase and implementing ContainerInjectionInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting entity type manager, moderation info, and bundle info services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting entity types and setting default moderation state.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to save the default moderation state configuration.
